crazing.definition: Fine network of cracks on the steel surface.
crazing.cause: Thermal stress during rapid cooling or rolling.
crazing.action: Inspect cooling spray nozzles and verify rolling temperature.

inclusion.definition: Non-metallic particles embedded in the steel.
inclusion.cause: Slag or refractory material entering the molten steel.
inclusion.action: Review ladle cleanliness and tundish practices.

patches.definition: Irregular, patch-like areas of discoloration or roughness.
patches.cause: Uneven cooling, oxidation, or localized scale buildup.
patches.action: Inspect descaling nozzles and verify cooling bed spray uniformity.

pitted_surface.definition: Small, shallow craters or pits scattered across the surface.
pitted_surface.cause: Gas evolution during solidification or localized corrosion.
pitted_surface.action: Review continuous casting parameters and check for moisture in mold flux.

rolled-in_scale.definition: Scale pressed into the steel surface during rolling.
rolled-in_scale.cause: Insufficient descaling or high-pressure water failure.
rolled-in_scale.action: Check descaling system pressure and roll condition.

scratches.definition: Linear grooves or abrasions on the steel surface.
scratches.cause: Mechanical friction from guide rolls or handling equipment.
scratches.action: Inspect roll surfaces and check conveyor belt tension.

punching_hole.definition: Holes or perforations caused by punching machinery.
punching_hole.cause: Incorrect punch alignment or worn-out tooling.
punching_hole.action: Inspect punching tools and verify alignment.

welding_line.definition: Visible weld seams or lines on the steel.
welding_line.cause: Improper welding parameters or seam tracking.
welding_line.action: Check welding current/voltage and inspect seam tracking sensors.

crescent_gap.definition: Crescent-shaped gaps or voids on the edge.
crescent_gap.cause: Improper strip tension or edge trimming issues.
crescent_gap.action: Adjust tension rollers and inspect edge trimming blades.

water_spot.definition: Stains or spots caused by water droplets.
water_spot.cause: Condensation or inadequate drying after cooling.
water_spot.action: Inspect drying systems and check for leaks in cooling lines.

oil_spot.definition: Dark stains or spots caused by oil contamination.
oil_spot.cause: Lubricant leakage from machinery or hydraulic lines.
oil_spot.action: Inspect hydraulic systems and clean lubricant applicators.

silk_spot.definition: Fine, thread-like spots or patterns on the surface.
silk_spot.cause: Inclusions or micro-structural anomalies rolled into the steel.
silk_spot.action: Review steel composition and casting parameters.

rolled_pit.definition: Small, localized depressions caused by rolled-in debris.
rolled_pit.cause: Foreign material (scale, slag) pressed into the surface.
rolled_pit.action: Improve descaling and check for debris on the rolling path.

crease.definition: Severe folding or overlapping of the steel surface.
crease.cause: Incorrect roll gap or excessive tension during rolling.
crease.action: Adjust roll gap and verify strip tension.

waist_folding.definition: Folding along the waist or middle of the steel strip.
waist_folding.cause: Improper width reduction or guide misalignment.
waist_folding.action: Adjust edger roll gap and inspect side guides.
